_about: Other state Assistant Professor exams shown as Coming soon cards on /exams/state-psc/ (CLAUDE.md rule 21). Each is a state commission's recruitment of Assistant Professors for government colleges, the same level as UP Assistant Professor. Checked by web search on 2026-11-15 that the commission has recruited Assistant Professors in English; no counts or dates are shown on the cards because they were not confirmed on the official sites. To open one, build its page and move it out of this list.
